message: Live Windows 2.2.17 evidence: after upgrade the exact legacy finalize path ran: finalize_legacy -> finalize -> finalize_failed reason=missing_page. I audited 2.2.17: finalize_page_observations already scans the marked replacement page first and then every other open chatgpt.com page, and positive identity is exact CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP user message or CONTROL READY. Therefore missing_page here means no surviving open ChatGPT page has provable control identity. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.18 in agent-handoff only. Requirements: (1) Add exactly one URL-scoped reprovision migration ONLY for the current consumed state: saved URL still old control URL; rebind_status=failed; rebind_failure_reason=no_new_url; rebind_bootstrap_sent=true (legacy 2.2.16 claim); replacement_count>=1/status=failed/reason=no_new_url; finalize_count>=1/status=failed/failure_reason=missing_page. It must not apply to any other state. (2) Before new_page persist rebind_reprovision_for_url, rebind_reprovision_count=1, rebind_reprovision_status=started. Restart/polls must never create a second reprovision page. If status=started and the marked reprovision page exists, resume only it; if it is missing, fail closed and permanently consume the attempt. (3) First, perform the same read-only scan of all open ChatGPT pages. If any usable new /c/ page has exact CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP user message or CONTROL READY, commit it and do not create a page. Only if there is no such proof may the one reprovision page be created. Never navigate unrelated conversation pages. (4) The reprovision page is a fresh service page marked before navigation, then navigate to https://chatgpt.com/, wait for composer hydration up to 20s, gate signed_out/hard_unavailable, and send CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP using the corrected 2.2.17 confirmation semantics. Because legacy rebind_bootstrap_sent=true is untrusted in this exact migration, do not let that legacy flag suppress this new reprovision send; instead use dedicated reprovision_bootstrap_attempted/submission_status fields. Fill the bootstrap at most once on the reprovision page. If Enter is unconfirmed and exact text remains in composer, allow at most one submit-only retry with a latch written before the retry; never refill text. (5) Confirmation must be exact user message, generation start, or transition to a new usable /c/ URL. After confirmed submit, wait up to 90s for a usable new /c/ URL while also accepting positive control identity. If URL appears, atomically commit it with replaced_from, preserve recovery/bootstrap/GitHub history, set reprovision done, and clear only blank/restore/rebind migration latches appropriate after success. Never persist home '/'. (6) If submit stays unconfirmed, signed out, hard unavailable, no composer, or no URL after confirmed submit, store a stable reprovision failure token and permanently consume the reprovision attempt. No new tab on later polls/restarts. (7) Tests: exact current 2.2.17 finalize-missing-page state => one reprovision; pre-scan finds positive existing page => commit/no new page; latch written before new_page; delayed composer; submit confirmed by exact user message; submit confirmed by generation; one submit-only retry without refill; successful /c/ persistence; restart with marked reprovision page resumes same page; restart with started latch but missing page fails closed; unrelated tabs untouched; all non-exact states ineligible; repeated polls no second page. Preserve CHECK_INTERVAL=5, 2.2.10 raw->api failover, text-free logs, main and arena/local-agent-v0 unchanged, no Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit write turn_id=53 target=GPT with SHA, changed files, exact tests and reprovision semantics.
